safety.policy_summary: KIS International School maintains rigorous safeguarding, child protection, and inclusion protocols. The school enforces safe recruitment practices including police criminal reference checks, mandatory staff training, robust CCTV and electronic access controls, on-site infirmaries with full-time nurses, and proactive air quality monitoring for PM2.5 levels.
